title: Closest storable fraction above contact
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > T, excluding only the principal pole. T is the closest fraction above the contact (777 - sqrt(1081))/852 that fits the tracker's 256-character bound field, about 2.16e-254 above it; its value is in Candidate/Main.lean. The reserve-parametric seed and above-half selected energy of positive-reserve-selected-gap are instantiated at smaller fixed positive gaps, giving the source G(1 - 10^-256, 2 + 10^-255, 0.15). The five count windows are kept, h is retuned, and the reserve and conductor extension fall to 10^-256. The box holding the contact no longer uses bisection: at p = 1/2 the top-edge row is a quadratic in delta with negative discriminant, and one Bernstein check carries the sign to p <= 1/2. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman, including the PR93 selected sextic norm, PR97 selected-leaf energy and PR98 physical return. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
